§6Assembler§f

§aThe workhorse of mid-game NuclearCraft.§f
The §bAssembler§f takes §b4 item inputs§f and produces §b1 output§f. Default cycle is §b600 ticks§f at §b10 RF/t§f. It handles plate crafting, part assembly, TRISO fuel coating, and more.

Almost every part and plate in NuclearCraft is built here. Basic Plates, Advanced Plates, DU Plates, Elite Plates, Chassis, Motors, Actuators, Servos, Solenoids. The Assembler is the bottleneck for scaling any NC production.

Build extras early. Seriously, you'll thank yourself later when you're not waiting on a single machine.

§ePS:§f TRISO fuel coating is done here too. If you're getting into advanced reactor fuels, you'll be using this machine a lot.
